definition: A guidance program is a structured set of educational and support activities used to increase people’s knowledge, awareness, and follow-through on a recommended behavior. In this source, it refers to individualized dietary guidance delivered by community pharmacists to help outpatients with chronic kidney disease follow potassium restriction more effectively.
